method.name: withPublicationFence
method.signature: withPublicationFence<T>(leaseId: string, generation: number, checkpointDigest: string, intentRef: string | null, publish: (frozenIntentRef: string, assertCurrent: () => void) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>
method.purpose: sc4-owned durable single-intent checkpoint freeze, recoverable completion-requested takeover and exclusive owner fence for bounded canonical publication. Null intentRef retrieves an already accepted intent on retry; conflicting intent refuses. Callback receives current-owner assertion for canonical CAS; terminal receipt persists separately.

body.rationale: Current s4 cannot reacquire completion-requested runs and cannot durably bind a publication intent. Required for s5 ac3 without unsafe cross-store exactly-once claims or adjacent-scope edits.
